payload.description: Qualification only across three separate families. 29:3 positive: exact put/get payload roundtrip and separation for source, IR, run header, snapshot, blob and indexes; negative: exact missing/wrong-key/index outcomes, preserve neighbors. 29:6 positive: exact bytes/namespace/order for every named key constructor; negative: malformed IDs and prefix/length boundaries. 29:8 positive: matching source/IR digest acceptance; negative: independently mutate each digest and assert exact typed mismatch. Map every API to source and registered checks with raw receipts, separate CODE and TEST; no duplicate implementation.
